## TRA Timeline

#### Abandoned 2016 IPO and form-of TRA

- 2016-06-30: Bioventus Inc. files initial S-1 for the 2016 IPO referencing the planned TRA.
- 2016-07-19: Amendment No. 1 to S-1 attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.1 (preamble dated "[●], 2016").
- 2016-12-31?: 2016 IPO withdrawn; the form-of TRA is never executed. Date inferred from absence of any 2017 amendment to the registration.

## Explanation

This is the form-of TRA attached to Bioventus's withdrawn 2016 IPO registration statement; it was never executed because the 2016 offering did not close. The planned terms were standard for an Up-C TRA: 85% of cash tax savings shared to pre-IPO members (Smith & Nephew, Inc. and Anthony P. Bihl III) on Section 754 basis step-ups from exchanges of LLC interests plus imputed interest. Bioventus returned to market in February 2021 with a distinct contract under a new registration statement, a different CEO, and only Smith & Nephew as the signing Member; see `bioventus-inc_TRA-2021-02-16_summary.qmd` for the executed contract. See `contract_log.md` for the same-contract reasoning that treats the 2016 and 2021 form-ofs as distinct contracts.
